loadtest_policy.content: Facilities Load-Test Policy LT-OPS-04 (rev 2025-09): Monthly units must be load-tested every 30 days under not less than 30 percent rated load for 30 minutes; Quarterly units every 90 days. A documented emergency run lasting at least 30 minutes under load within the prior 30 days satisfies the load-test requirement and resets the clock to the emergency run date. Units 'Under Repair' are excluded until cleared by the maintenance lead. Portable 'Event' units are governed by the events power schedule, not this policy. Scheduling lead time: load tests must be booked at least 3 business days ahead so the crew can stage fuel and signage.

crew_availability.content: Maintenance crew availability, week of 2026-02-09 to 2026-02-22. Crew A (Reyes, Patel): available Mon/Wed/Fri mornings; Crew B (Okafor, Lindqvist): available Tue/Thu all day. Blackout: 2026-02-16 (Presidents Day, no crew). Each load test slot is 2 hours; max 2 generators per crew per day. On-call lead: D. Reyes, ext. 4412.

facilities_calendar.content: Facilities Operations shared calendar (calendar id: facilities-ops@nyc-grid.example). Existing entries in window: 2026-02-11 'Substation quarterly inspection' 09:00-11:00; 2026-02-19 'Fuel polishing - warehouse tanks' 13:00-15:00. Calendar is used to book load-test slots and auto-invites assigned crew members.

tools.name: query_substation_generators
tools.description: Read the substation generator inventory rows (model, frequency, status, assignment, last load test, notes).

tools.name: query_warehouse_units
tools.description: Read the warehouse and portable generator unit rows (model, frequency, status, assignment, last load test, notes).

tools.name: retrieve_loadtest_policy
tools.description: Read the facilities load-test policy LT-OPS-04 covering testing frequency, emergency-run credit, exclusions, and scheduling lead time.

tools.name: retrieve_crew_availability
tools.description: Read maintenance crew availability, blackout dates, and per-day slot capacity for the testing window.

tools.name: compute_loadtest_due_dates
tools.description: Apply the Monthly/Quarterly frequency rules, emergency-run credit, and exclusions (Under Repair, Event-assigned portables) to determine which generators are due for load testing within 14 days of 2026-02-09.

tools.name: draft_loadtest_schedule
tools.description: Assemble a draft load-testing schedule (which generators, proposed dates, assigned crew) for the user's review. Does not book anything or notify anyone.

tools.name: create_calendar_loadtest_events
tools.description: Create detailed load-test events on the Facilities Operations shared calendar, which auto-invites the assigned crew members.

tools.name: email_crew_loadtest_notification
tools.description: Send email notifications to maintenance crew members informing them of their assigned load-test dates and staging requirements.

tools.name: update_generator_status_scheduled
tools.description: Update generator inventory records to mark units as 'Load Test Scheduled' with the booked date.

tools.name: lookup_crew_directory
tools.description: Look up maintenance team contact details and crew assignments from the directory.

tools.name: view_facilities_calendar
tools.description: Read existing entries on the Facilities Operations shared calendar to spot conflicts in the testing window.
